parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou:** the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1:** outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule template whose status you want to change.

parameters.name: TemplateStatus
parameters.description:
The new status of the protection rule template. Valid values:

*   **0:** disabled.
*   **1:** enabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-template-status --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 2249 --template-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
